memory_candidates.content: When a task's scope changes from code implementation to documentation-only, the plan can be replaced entirely rather than revised incrementally. Key pattern: update state.json dependencies first, then add docstrings, then verify with lake build. Documentation-only changes in Lean files carry zero proof risk since docstrings are comments.
